entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Forested mountain range of central New Argive, home of the aesthir.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: One of the Terisian Isles, formed during the peacemaking between Balduvia and Kjeldor.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Island group that includes New Argive.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Karplusan Mountains lie.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation that warred with Balduvia during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Nation that warred with Kjeldor during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Darien's Roost
entities.description: First Kjeldoran outpost in the Karplusan Mountains, later called Epityr.

entities.name: Aesthir
entities.description: Giant birds of prey that can be trained as flying mounts.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Era in which the mountains were covered with ice.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Period after the Ice Age when Darien's Roost became Epityr.

events.summary: During the Ice Age the Karplusans freeze and form the border between Kjeldor and Balduvia.
events.quote: formed the border between the two warring nations of Kjeldor and Balduvia

events.summary: Darien's Roost is built as the first Kjeldoran outpost during the peacemaking and the formation of New Argive.
events.quote: Darien's Roost was the first Kjeldoran outpost allowed in the Karplusan Mountains

events.summary: During the Thaw Darien's Roost becomes known as Epityr.
events.quote: During the Thaw , this location became known as Epityr

relations.quote: The Karplusan Mountains are the forested mountain range of central New Argive
The mountains are the home of the aesthir
